description: M3-C retrieval query set: 10 representative laptop, headphones, tablet, mouse and keyboard requests. The retrieval experiment uses the current production effective query construction but a category-scoped candidate corpus.

queries.query: 推荐一台 5000 元的笔记本
queries.purpose: Laptop budget request where chargers/adapters/batteries dominated the current top-5.

queries.query: 推荐一台 8000 元的游戏笔记本
queries.purpose: Gaming laptop request with an explicit budget and use case.

queries.query: 推荐一台 6000 元的办公笔记本
queries.purpose: Office laptop request; tests category scope under a different use case.

queries.query: 推荐一台 1000 元的游戏笔记本
queries.purpose: A low-budget gaming laptop query; mostly a retrieval stress case.

queries.query: I need some new headphones. Not sure what matters yet.
queries.purpose: General headphones query from the M3-B Golden Dataset.

queries.query: 推荐一款 500 元的游戏耳机
推荐一款 500 元的降噪耳机
推荐一台 3000 元的学习平板
queries.purpose: Tablet request; tests whether category scope removes tablet cases/chargers.

queries.query: 推荐一个 300 元的无线鼠标
queries.purpose: Mouse request with a budget; tests mouse pads/other accessories.

queries.query: 推荐一把 500 元的机械键盘
queries.purpose: Keyboard request with a budget; tests keyboard covers/stickers/pads.
